title: The Celestial Expanse
description: The Celestial Expanse is an Interstellar WorldBuilding & Nations-like Server! Explore, Colonize, and Conquer vast Procedural Planets! Construct a Metropolis! Build your own Vehicles! All with only requiring a custom Resource Pack!
body:
(JAVA EDITION ONLY)
The Celestial Expanse : An Interstellar WorldBuilding & Nations-like Server.

Custom Server StarMap
[https://celestialmc.zapto.org/maps/starcivs/](https://celestialmc.zapto.org/maps/starcivs/)

Having been in the making for over 10 Years by an independant/solo-developer...

> 
> **🤯** We are Entirely Vanilla Compatible! No need to download a whole Modpack to play this!
> 
> *However you may find that Sodium and other Optimization Mods will help with performance.*
> 
> **🚀** Working, Combat-capable NPC Pirate Ships!
> 
> *Players may also build working Starships, Tanks and more, all out of blocks!*
> 
> These mechanics are empowered by our own custom **Movecraft**-like vehicle system, which is used as the backbone of the server!
> 
> **🌌** An ever-E X P A N D I N G Galaxy of Planets, Asteroid Fields and Nebula!
> 
> All our Worlds are procedurally generated with unique Terrain & Biomes on each! Not one Planet is (too) similar to another!
> 
> **🔋** An Exclusive, custom Automation system with several forms of power generation and material production.
> 
> Utilizing a heavily customized territory system, built off of `Towns & Nations`, allowing for flexible Claiming and Nation creation.
> 
> Use a Ship-based Warping system, used to move between vast Planets and travel the Interstellar Void!
> 
> **🪐** Go above and beyond, and Start your Colonial Empire today!
